name: saved_items
rule: at most 50 saved screens and 50 My metrics
example_ok: saving a new screen while 49 are saved
example_refused: saving a new screen while 50 are saved (delete one first)

name: watchlist
rule: at most 500 tickers in the watchlist
example_ok: watching a new ticker while 499 are watched
example_refused: watching a new ticker while 500 are watched (remove one first)

name: saved_definition_bytes
rule: a saved screen or My metric is at most 65,536 bytes of JSON as stored (a space after each colon and comma)
example_refused: a saved definition of 65,537 bytes (remove conditions or filters)

name: request_bytes
rule: a request to the screener is at most 131,072 bytes
example_refused: a run request of 131,073 bytes (remove conditions or filters)

name: inflight_per_page
unit: requests of each kind per page
rule: 1 screen and 1 preview in flight per page: a newer one replaces the older one, which is answered as replaced
example_ok: a preview while the same page runs a screen, or a screen run in another tab
example_refused: a second screen of the same page while its first is running (the first is replaced; nothing to do)
